pages.title: The tower keeper
pages.text: 'Don't let too many people see this.' The tower keeper glanced at the traveller's staff and pushed an old book across the table.$(br2)It told of ways to strengthen staves, bows and crossbows. Some feared its power, and called it Forbidden Knowledge.

pages.title: Secrets in the pages
pages.text: Powerful creatures and level Bosses may leave this book behind.$(br2)Place it with a Nether Star and a suitable staff, bow or crossbow in a smithing table to strengthen the equipment. Each enhancement consumes one infusion.
